name: Bhagavad Gita 17.15
text:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
meaning: Speech that causes no distress, that is truthful, kind and beneficial, and the regular study of scripture: this is called the discipline of speech.
purpose: Speech that is truthful, beneficial, gentle and non-harmful.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
